_meta.description: Innovation and R&D assets in the priority regions: universities, Catapult centres and other research and innovation centres. Compiled 14 November 2026. Universities, coordinates, websites, dates and student numbers come from Wikidata; other coordinates were geocoded with Nominatim (OpenStreetMap). Summaries are one-line descriptions, not sourced from board papers. Not exhaustive.
